about: Offline evaluation set for the anti-slop check and the de-slop rewrite. flagged and kept: the exact tell ids. unchanged: the rewrite returns the text as it is. keeps: words that the rewrite keeps. drops: words that the rewrite removes from the prompt (an added Avoid line can name them). contradiction: tells that the prompt asks for and forbids. See docs/evaluation.md.
